chapters.label: What it is
chapters.heading: Rizq is not just money
chapters.line: Health. Family. Peace of mind. Even your next breath.

quote.english: And there is no creature on earth but that upon Allah is its provision, and He knows its place of dwelling and place of storage. All is in a clear register.
quote.arabic: ۞ وَمَا مِن دَاۤبَّةࣲ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ رِزۡقُهَا وَيَعۡلَمُ مُسۡتَقَرَّهَا وَمُسۡتَوۡدَعَهَاۚ كُلࣱّ فِي كِتَـٰبࣲ مُّبِينࣲ

chapters.label: Key one
chapters.heading: Ask forgiveness
chapters.line: The first key. Turn back, and ask.

quote.english: And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver. He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers.
quote.arabic: فَقُلۡتُ ٱسۡتَغۡفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمۡ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارࣰا يُرۡسِلِ ٱلسَّمَاۤءَ عَلَيۡكُم مِّدۡرَارࣰا

chapters.label: Key two
chapters.heading: Be grateful
chapters.line: The second key. Say thank you, and mean it.

quote.english: And [remember] when your Lord proclaimed, 'If you are grateful, I will surely increase you [in favor]; but if you deny, indeed, My punishment is severe.
quote.arabic: وَإِذۡ تَأَذَّنَ رَبُّكُمۡ لَئِن شَكَرۡتُمۡ لَأَزِيدَنَّكُمۡۖ وَلَئِن كَفَرۡتُمۡ إِنَّ عَذَابِي لَشَدِيدࣱ

chapters.label: Key three
chapters.heading: Stay mindful
chapters.line: The third key. Stay mindful of Him.

quote.english: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out. And will provide for him from where he does not expect.

chapters.label: Remember
chapters.heading: Do your part
chapters.line: Do your part. Then let your heart rest.

chapters.label: Sabr
chapters.heading: Sabr, explained slowly
chapters.line: Everyone says, be patient. Few explain what it means.

chapters.label: What it is
chapters.heading: Not silence. Not giving up.
chapters.line: It still hurts. Patience is staying steady anyway.

chapters.label: You are not alone
chapters.heading: Help comes with patience
chapters.line: While you wait, you are not waiting alone.

quote.english: O you who have believed, seek help through patience and prayer. Indeed, Allah is with the patient.
quote.arabic: يَـٰۤأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱسۡتَعِينُوا۟ بِٱلصَّبۡرِ وَٱلصَّلَوٰةِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ

chapters.label: A test
chapters.heading: Tests are part of the road
chapters.line: Hard days do not mean you were forgotten.

quote.english: And We will surely test you with something of fear and hunger and a loss of wealth and lives and fruits, but give good tidings to the patient.
quote.arabic: وَلَنَبۡلُوَنَّكُم بِشَيۡءࣲ مِّنَ ٱلۡخَوۡفِ وَٱلۡجُوعِ وَنَقۡصࣲ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَمۡوَ ٰلِ وَٱلۡأَنفُسِ وَٱلثَّمَرَ ٰتِۗ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ

chapters.label: The first moment
chapters.heading: Real patience is early
chapters.line: The first moment is where it counts.

quote.english: “The real patience is at the first stroke of a calamity”
For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease. Indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
quote.arabic: فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلۡعُسۡرِ يُسۡرًا إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلۡعُسۡرِ يُسۡرࣰا
